description: NaZn₂HSe₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-78°. There are three shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four ZnO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.04 Å) and four longer (2.18 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.22 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.73 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) Se-O bond lengths. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.73 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) Se-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Zn and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Zn and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Zn, and one Se atom to form corner-sharing ONaZn₂Se tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one Se atom.
